## 1. Prediction market

The confirmed reading of Aug 16, at 4:56 pm BRT, brings a new number for **every** tracked contract. In the [presidential market](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), **Lula stands at 66.50% (USD 8.40M)**, up 2.00pp. The **total accumulated volume in the presidential book adds up to USD 124.32M**.

⭐ That value **matches the top of the whole series**: among the 174 points recorded since May 19 none is above it, and the only other day at that level was Aug 1.

⚠️ And the order of events matters: the point was recorded at **5:01 am BRT**, before any campaign rally. The price moved going into the day, not in reaction to the rallies.

**Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 29.45% (USD 8.34M)**, up 1.30pp and a third straight higher close. Even while rising, he ended up further away: the gap **widened** to **37.05pp**. ⛔ Neither figure is a record: 4 of his 173 points were higher, and 30 of the 89 days had an equal or larger gap, with a peak of 41.80pp.

⭐ **The most informative move of the day is in the placing contract, not the victory one.** **Renan Santos fell to 4.70% (USD 9.77M)** and broke below 5% for the first time in the window. In the [third-place contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place) he still leads, at 53.00% (USD 181 thousand), but he is falling there too: it was 65.00% on Aug 9. **Ronaldo Caiado went the other way**, dropping to 0.60% (USD 5.92M) on victory and **rising to 37.50% on third place**, against 31.00% on Aug 12. The distance between the two there narrowed from 30.50pp to 15.50pp in four days.

Zema (0.15%) and Haddad (0.05%) remain below the 0.5% cutoff. The [Supreme Court impeachment contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) eased to 3.40% (USD 84 thousand), the thinnest among those tracked.

## 2. What the polling institutes registered

No new national poll came out on Aug 16. The [Genial/Quaest of Aug 14](https://news.google.?oc=5) still stands, with 38% x 31% in the first round and 43% x 40% in the runoff.

⭐ **The weekend's news is not about level, it is about firmness.** A crosstab of that same poll, released on Aug 15 by [G1](https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral/noticia/2026/08/15/quaest-decisao-voto-14-agosto.ghtml), shows **77% of Lula's voters** calling the decision final, against 22% who could still change, and points to **Romeu Zema** as having the least convinced electorate in the field. That measures the hardness of the intention, not its size.

Candidate filing closed on Aug 15. [Poder360](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxNcmxJWGpoWWgtX3dwdWNzRnNydTJUeUx5SUV0ZXhBbGpyQXZ1bDZ6LUpZc204aDdDRnJhSUJweDBBX3Fmc29QYWkxTTlONFNJSmdYdFRQeXFKRWs2RUhaSVpTNWpOLWhGWEVZaS1oWVlHb2RPTVhlYS1za3ptQUtKcTlLSkx4VTNlRENtS185Z2RieFVEbkJuaWFLc21BMXk3UVQwXzE5NzkzUQ?oc=5) counted **20,438 candidacies as of 7:30 pm that Saturday**, and notes that the figure remains incomplete because the Electoral Court is still processing filings. For the presidency there are [13 names](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQS2RDQmVnM0xKMGRsdVpwYzRTYUhQcWI5eEIwd2ZDdnh6YkU2emJoYmt4RG1nMnhMdXpXTTE4R1ZjMFlhNDJWbG5ocm5NQnhtSktPYlVsNGpOdzFndl8yakNrRkpTcEhrRlBGY2hxVHYzaFIxT3JXVVctb0ZVYWVsdmIwemRHM2ZtMEFuR3J1Z0ZycktzNUZUQkJwcTNBTzlZMERfZG53?oc=5).

## 3. What the press covered

The [electoral campaign began on Aug 16](https://news.google.?oc=5). Lula opened at the [Vila Euclides stadium in São Bernardo](https://valor.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/08/16/em-sua-ultima-disputa-lula-volta-as-origens-em-sbc-e-acena-a-trabalhadores-jovens-e-mulheres.ghtml), and [promised a Security Ministry](https://news.google.?oc=5).

⚠️ **The day produced one crowd measurement and only one.** According to [Estadão](https://news.google.?oc=5), the USP/Cebrap monitor estimated **8,900 people** in Copacabana, and Lula's rally **had no measurement released**. ⛔ With a number on one side and none on the other, comparing the rallies is not possible.

[Renan Santos opened at the University of São Paulo law school](https://g1.globo.com/politica/eleicoes/2026/noticia/2026/08/16/renan-santos-inicia-campanha-a-presidencia-em-sao-paulo.ghtml), wearing a bulletproof vest, and [Zema opened with a mass in Montes Claros](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/08/zema-inicia-campanha-com-promessa-de-superpresidio-e-criticas-a-ministros-do-stf.shtml), criticising Supreme Court justices. The court became a starting theme: [G1 reported](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5) that Flávio Bolsonaro's Senate strategy is built around confronting the Supreme Court, and Lula's around governability.

Three names from the presidential book opened campaigns for **other offices**: [Tarcísio de Freitas for re-election in São Paulo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/08/16/tarcisio-da-largada-na-campanha-a-reeleicao-ao-governo-de-sp-em-osasco.ghtml), without Flávio Bolsonaro present; Haddad for the same state's governorship; and [Michelle Bolsonaro for the Senate seat of the Federal District](https://redir.folha.com.br/redir/online/poder/rss091/*https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/08/michelle-bolsonaro-da-largada-a-candidatura-ao-senado-missao-que-meu-marido-me-confiou.shtml). That turns inference into a dated act. In the Master case, [Estadão reported](https://www.estadao.com.br/economia/apos-perdas-com-banco-master-85-das-previdencias-so-podem-investir-em-titulos-publicos/) that 85% of pension schemes may now invest only in government bonds.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × market:** victory and placing answered in opposite ways for the same name. Caiado fell 0.45pp in the race for the presidency and rose 6.50pp on third place. Finishing third and winning are different questions, and the panel does not add them together.

> **Price × calendar:** the rise was recorded at 5:01 am BRT, before any rally. Reading the day backwards attributes the move to the rallies, and the timestamps do not allow it.

> **Narrative × measurement:** the two largest rallies drew adjectives in the coverage, but only one drew a number. An estimate on one side and none on the other do not make a comparison.

## In summary

1. **The leader matched the top of the series at 66.50%**, with no point above it in 174 records. Matching is not beating.
2. **The third-place contract said more than the victory one:** Caiado rose 6.50pp on placing and fell 0.45pp in the race, and his distance to the chasing pack’s leader in that book narrowed from 30.50pp to 15.50pp.
3. **With no new poll, the finding came from firmness:** 77% of the leader’s voters call the decision final, and the least convinced electorate in the field is Zema’s.
